subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

M N O _ M N _ _ M N _ P _ _ O P
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: M N O _ M N _ _ M N _ P _ _ O P

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) POPOMN → M N O __**P**__ / M N __**O**__ __**P**__ / M N __**O**__ P / __**M**__ __**N**__ O P

Here, '**MNOP**' followed a pattern.

Option 2) POPOMM → M N O __P__ / M N __O__ __P__ / M N __O__ P / __M__ **__M__** O P

Option 3) NMPONM → M N O **__N__** / M N **__M__** __P__ / M N __O__ P / **__N__** **__M__** O P

Option 4) MNPOPP → M N O **__M__** / M N **__N__** __P__ / M N __O__ P / **__P__** **__P__** O P

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
